lens_fit.jacobian: J_l = E_{t, t'>=t, prompt}[ d h_final,t' / d h_l,t ]
lens_fit.estimator: unbiased rank-m stochastic estimate from m Jacobian-vector products; m is recorded per fit and a rank-m estimate is never described as the exact Jacobian
lens_fit.floor_rationale: The amaljithkuttamath replication fitted at n=25 with skip_first=4 and its shuffled-corpus lens scored >= the real lens on all six evaluations (typo MRR 0.806 vs 0.318). These floors keep this project out of that regime. The exact scale above the floor is a Phase-A calibration object.
lens_fit.aggregation: paired mean of both real lenses; the lens fit is the outermost bootstrap level

readout_reliability.criterion: both real lenses reach top-25 recall >= threshold on held-out corpus

corpus_necessity.criterion: the real-corpus lens beats the shuffled-corpus lens on the held-out readout criterion
corpus_necessity.note: Failing this reproduces amaljithkuttamath's finding and the subject is out.

vs_logit_lens.criterion: on the FIRST HALF of the band the real lens is no worse than the logit lens
vs_logit_lens.note: Superiority across all layers is NOT required. The paper states the logit lens captures much of the workspace-like structure, with lower reliability particularly in earlier layers, so the first half of the band is where the two are claimed to diverge.

causal_positive_control.criterion: a known intermediate swap moves the target in the registered direction, and a matched-norm random perturbation does not

general_damage.criterion: the output-KL distributions of the J-space ablation and the layer-matched random ablation are separable
general_damage.note: If they are not separable at a given strength tier, that tier is void.

phase_b_qualification.on_failure: Any FAIL removes that subject; no patching, no re-run. If either subject fails, SC1 applies and RQ1 closes permanently for the failing side.

ablation.k_note: Fixed at Freeze-2 from Phase A. The paper's reference value is k = 10.
ablation.band_note: Fixed at Freeze-2 from the automatic rule in configs/freeze1/band_rule.json.
ablation.strength_definition: by layer band: light = first third of the band, medium = first two thirds, heavy = the whole band

rerun_policy.infrastructure_reruns: permitted, pre-registered; codes and budgets are frozen in wda.governance.rerun_policy
rerun_policy.scientific_reruns: forbidden: no re-run for an unwelcome result, no seed change, no band change, no k change, no delta change, no added samples, no endpoint change
